name: How do I measure the success of AEO for my electrical business?

mainEntity.name: How do I measure the success of AEO for my electrical business?

acceptedAnswer.text: Measuring AEO success involves tracking several key metrics. Look at increased visibility in featured snippets and 'People Also Ask' sections, higher rankings for question-based keywords, and a rise in traffic from organic search, especially from voice search. Monitoring engagement metrics, such as click-through rates to your website and conversions (e.g., calls, form submissions), also helps determine AEO's impact on generating leads for your electrical services.
acceptedAnswer.description: Measure AEO success by tracking featured snippet visibility, question-based keyword rankings, organic traffic, and conversions from search.
